lines.text: Last year, Leo got hiking boots as a gift.
He didn't know which trail to pick, what to pack, or how long it would take.
This year, his sister gave him the plan to go with them:
a beginner's guide to choose an easy first trail, a packing checklist, and a trip planner to fill in.
Two weeks later, the boots were muddy.
Save this if you're buying a hiker a gift.
